t('slug,name,active').eq('published_once',true).eq('is_upcoming',false).order('name');
      if(error){ sel.innerHTML='<option value="">No se pudo cargar</option>'; return; }
      sel.innerHTML=(data||[]).map(p=>`<option value="${escapeAttr(p.slug)}" data-name="${escapeAttr(p.name)}">${escapeAttr(p.name)}${p.active?'':' · oculto'}</option>`).join('');
      return;
    }
    const {data:drafts}=await client.from('products').select('slug,name').eq('published_once',false).eq('active',false);
    const map=new Map(); UPCOMING_PRODUCTS.forEach(p=>map.set(p.slug,p)); (drafts||[]).forEach(p=>map.set(p.slug,p));
    sel.innerHTML=Array.from(map.values()).sort((a,b)=>a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'es')).map(p=>`<option value="${escapeAttr(p.slug)}" data-name="${escapeAttr(p.name)}">${escapeAttr(p.name)}</option>`).join('');
  }

  async function loadPurchases(){
    const body=document.getElementById('purchasesBody'), msg=document.getElementById('purchasesMsg'); body.innerHTML='';
    const {data,error}=await client.from('inventory_purchases').select('*').order('purchase_date',{ascending:false}).order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(50);
    if(error){showMsg(msg,error.message,'error');return;}
    if(!(data||[]).length){body.innerHTML='<tr><td colspan="9" style="color:var(--ink-soft);">Aún no hay compras registradas.</td></tr>';return;}
    (data||[]).forEach(r=>{
      const total=Number(r.merchandise_cost||0)+Number(r.logistics_cost||0);
      const state=r.status==='received'?'Recibida':r.status==='cancelled'?'Cancelada':'En camino';
      const badge=r.status==='received'?'badge-paid':r.status==='cancelled'?'badge-cancelled':'badge-pending';
      const type=r.purchase_type==='new_drop'?'Nuevo drop':'Reposición';
      const action=r.status==='ordered'?`<div class="actions-cell"><button class="action-confirm" data-buy-action="receive" data-id="${r.id}" data-name="${escapeAttr(r.product_name)}" data-qty="${r.quantity}">Recibir</button><button class="danger-ghost" data-buy-action="cancel" data-id="${r.id}" data-name="${escapeAttr(r.product_name)}">Cancelar</button></div>`:'';
      const sizes=r.status==='received'?`<div class="helper-text">S ${r.qty_s} · M ${r.qty_m} · L ${r.qty_l} · XL ${r.qty_xl}</div>`:'';
      const tr=document.createElement('tr'); tr.innerHTML=`<td><strong>${escapeAttr(r.product_name)}</strong>${sizes}</td><td>${type}</td><td>${r.quantity}</td><td>${moneyFmt(r.merchandise_cost)}</td><td>${moneyFmt(r.logistics_cost)}</td><td><strong>${moneyFmt(total)}</strong></td><td>${new Date(r.purchase_date+'T12:00:00').toLocaleDateString('es-PA')}</td><td><span class="badge ${badge}">${state}</span></td><td>${action}</td>`; body.appendChild(tr);
    });
  }

  document.getElementById('purchaseType').addEventListener('change',loadPurchaseOptions);
  document.getElementById('registerPurchaseBtn').addEventListener('click',async()=>{
    const msg=document.getElementById('purchasesMsg'), btn=document.getElementById('registerPurchaseBtn'), sel=document.getElementById('purchaseProductSelect'), opt=sel.options[sel.selectedIndex];
    const qty=parseInt(document.getElementById('purchaseQty').value,10)||0, merchandise=parseFloat(document.getElementById('purchaseMerchandiseCost').value), logistics=parseFloat(document.getElementById('purchaseLogisticsCost').value||'0'), date=document.getElementById('purchaseDate').value;
    if(!sel.value||!opt){showMsg(msg,'Selecciona un producto.','error');return;} if(qty<=0){showMsg(msg,'Cantidad inválida.','error');return;} if(isNaN(merchandise)||merchandise<=0){showMsg(msg,'Indica el costo de mercancía.','error');return;} if(!date){showMsg(msg,'Selecciona la fecha.','error');return;}
    btn.disabled=true; const {error}=await client.rpc('create_inventory_purchase',{p_purchase_type:document.getElementById('purchaseType').value,p_product_slug:sel.value,p_product_name:opt.dataset.name||opt.textContent,p_quantity:qty,p_merchandise_cost:merchandise,p_logistics_cost:logistics,p_purchase_date:da
